roll.guideLocked: Your fixed rate is locked only until the Boros legs <hi>mature</hi>. A roll closes those rate legs and reopens the same pair at a later maturity. <hi>Your perps never move.</hi>
roll.guideEdge: That is the whole edge: a new position pays <hi>two perp entry fees plus slippage on the full notional</hi>. A roll pays none of it — only Boros trade fees on the rate legs. Same spread, <g>materially higher APR on your capital.</g>
roll.whenLastDays: <hi>In the last {{days}} days.</hi> Rolling early lets you <g>DCA into the longer maturity</g> — several entries at different rates instead of one, which smooths the yield you lock in.
roll.whenPaysMore: <hi>When the next maturity pays more</hi> than you earn now, after the round trip's fees. The banner says so when it does.
roll.whenMatures: <hi>Right when it matures</hi>, if you mean to keep farming. Let it lapse and your perps sit unhedged on floating funding.
roll.notRolling: Not rolling is fine — closing both perps ends the position cleanly. Doing neither is what costs you.
